source_decision.reason: Fivetran connections, destinations, groups, transformations, keys, agents, and webhooks are pipeline administration or infrastructure resources. The official OpenAPI does not prove a canonical task, note, or user-work project with a durable version and deletion or tombstone contract for warehouse synchronization.

audit_findings_folded.finding: A shared authenticated ingredient would send Basic credentials to the official anonymous public endpoint.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Isolated Public Endpoints in a connectionless leaf and asserted its security array, ingredient, recipe step, and dependency boundary.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Two Connector SDK package mutations require binary ZIP multipart uploads the REST binding cannot construct.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Excluded exactly those two routes as transport_unbuildable and retained the four buildable package metadata operations.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The OpenAPI omits requestBody.required on every body even where mutations need provider-declared payload fields.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Requires bounded complete body_raw on all 64 admitted JSON-body operations and sends it verbatim.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Seven GET responses can contain recoverable connection tokens, system-key secrets, or webhook secrets.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Kept the capabilities directly callable but suppressed all seven from bundled rendering workflows.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Destination, log-service, and external-secrets-manager detail responses can also carry password-formatted or structurally unbounded provider configuration.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Expanded sensitive workflow suppression to all 12 credential-bearing or credential-capable GET operations while retaining their direct capabilities.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Two ESM collection responses declare next_cursor while their requests declare neither cursor nor limit.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Returns data.items but labels both workflows single-page and refuses to invent undocumented continuation inputs.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Thirty-one cursor collections expose caller cursor and limit fields that could conflict with automatic traversal.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Binding-owned cursor and limit are omitted from caller args; the page size is pinned to the documented maximum of 1000.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Nineteen connection and destination routes require the version=2 Accept parameter rather than plain application/json.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Preserved each OpenAPI Accept default as a fixed per-operation header and made it non-overridable.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Two fingerprint approvals declare both an empty 200 and a JSON 201 success response.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Preserved the exact success-status union and permits either an empty string result or the documented JSON envelope.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The Connector SDK download response media says application/json while its official operation description explicitly promises a raw ZIP octet-stream.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Overrides only that inconsistent Accept value to application/octet-stream, captures bytes as a private ZIP file_ref, and suppresses ordinary text rendering.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Action-shaped POSTs such as resync, rotation, credential reset, move, cancellation, upgrade, and transformation runs can be materially destructive.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Classified the reviewed action set as destructive; all PATCH and DELETE operations are also destructive and every mutation requires approval.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Ordinary JSON parsing can round provider integer identifiers or counters beyond JavaScript's safe range.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Enabled lossless unsafe-integer string parsing on every admitted response and permits exact integer strings in compact response schemas.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Automatic retries could amplify provider setup-test and sync rate limits or replay non-idempotent actions.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Marks POST and PATCH calls non-idempotent, surfaces 429 responses, and pins Retry-After plus provider rate-limit evidence without inventing a retry policy.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Pipeline administration objects are tempting but dishonest task, note, or user-work project Sources.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Declares no work_entity_sources and records the semantic rejection in the audit fixture.
